title: Adding Tens and Ones Within 100
description: Add tens and ones within 100 using base-ten models, place-value reasoning, and visual exchanges that make a new ten.
learningFocus: Add within 100 by combining tens with tens and ones with ones, using place-value models and composing a new ten when needed.
adultGuidance: Ask your child to name the tens and ones before adding and explain which place changes. When 10 or more ones are combined, use the worksheet language: circle 10 ones, exchange them for 1 new ten, then count the remaining tens and ones; avoid introducing a carried-digit shortcut before the model makes sense.
